description: Edit the official transcript text of a single media file by finding and replacing text. Replaces every occurrence of the original text with the replacement (leave replacement empty to delete the text) and reports how many occurrences were replaced. Use update_transcript_speakers to rename speaker labels instead.

caseSensitive.description: Match case exactly when finding the original text

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the media file

original.description: Text to find in the transcript

replacement.description: Text to replace it with (empty string deletes the matched text)

name: update_transcription

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Update Transcription Text
